verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed instructions. The Financial Connections docs themselves are served as Markdown (.md) pages, confirmed by probe and cited across the docs. Stripe's official MCP server also lets agents search the documentation knowledge base. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt specifically indexes the Financial Connections pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
